TARGET_AUDIENCE: Indian travellers aged 24–34 who constantly save scenic Kashmir reels and want to plan an authentic valley trip, but get overwhelmed trying to stitch together flights, Dal Lake houseboats, and alpine stays across multiple booking apps.
PAIN_POINT: Planning a Kashmir trip means juggling separate portals for Srinagar houseboats, Gulmarg hotels, and Pahalgam cab transfers—by the time one booking is confirmed on one app, the flight date or stay availability on another has shifted, leaving a fragmented itinerary with mismatched dates.
DESTINATION: Kashmir Valley (Srinagar, Gulmarg, and Pahalgam circuit)
CREATIVE_ANGLE: They know they want the classic Kashmir circuit—houseboats in Srinagar, the Gulmarg heights, and Pahalgam's valleys—but managing disconnected reservations across tabs risks ruining the flow of the trip. With Travafa's booking in the plan, flights, boutique stays, and local activities are searched, booked, and directly attached to each day of the timeline so reservations and itinerary stay perfectly in sync.
LOOK_CONSTRAINTS: time_of_day: night, lit by artificial and practical lights; weather: active monsoon rain, visible raindrops; palette: warm earth tones, ochre and terracotta; film_look: handheld documentary feel, minor natural shake; human_presence: one traveller, face visible
HOOK_STYLE: the character speaks straight to camera from the first frame, already mid-problem
PACING_SHAPE: compress the problem to the minimum needed to feel real; expand the product demonstration into the largest beat
ENDING_STYLE: the character turns directly to camera in the final part and speaks the CTA themselves; the environment is present but secondary
DIALOGUE_DENSITY: keep the earliest part more visual and silent; let dialogue increase as the story reaches the product and result beats
CharacterStyle: A 28-year-old traveller wearing a heavy rust-ochre ribbed knit sweater over an olive-khaki base layer, with a warm woollen muffler draped loosely around the neck and a matte metal ring on the right index finger.
Setting: A cosy cedarwood-panelled room with intricate Kashmiri walnut wood latticework, illuminated by soft amber bedside lamps, with rain-streaked glass windows reflecting warm terracotta interior tones as heavy monsoon rain falls outside into the dark.
ReferenceTone: Handheld documentary realism with subtle organic motion, rich earthy terracotta and ochre palette, intimate low-light atmosphere with soft rain glints and tactile wooden textures.
PhoneShotAction: The traveller sits at a rustic wooden desk with physical handwritten route notes and printed hotel receipts laid out, tapping the smartphone screen as Travafa searches and instantly attaches a Srinagar houseboat booking directly into Day 1 of the in-app timeline.
